af9d6fc41faa99c0a823.text: To help you better understand the concept on transition signals, you need to deepen your knowledge and understanding by discovering what the topic is all about. Study the given sentences below.

1bd0af44db9aef5dfd69.text:
1. Threats and trials were rough.
2. Life is full of challenges but meant to be well.
In sentence number one, the transition signal ‘and’ is used to connect two incidents equally.
While in sentence number two, the transition signal ‘but’ introduces the opposite ideas.
Take note that simple conjunctions serve different purposes. Conjunctions that join words,
phrases, or clauses together are the most basic transition signals.
The words ‘and’ and ‘but’ are examples of transition signals.

ed28dea3d462692d030d.text: Transition signals are words and phrases that connect ideas of sentences and paragraphs for coherence. They also indicate building up new idea or thought or compare ideas or draw conclusions.

d4d10b85f291521d631f.text: Transition signals are of different types and each type helps to make certain connections. Common Types and Functions of Transition Words:

711bfa73187a8fe7e6b5.text: 1. Comparison/Contrast points out alternatives or differences:

rows: as also likewise similarly in the same way
but despite however even though on the contrary
bf3385c29278454098f1.text: Comparison Contrast as also likewise similarly in the same way but despite however even though on the contrary

f4128beece023988a7a6.text: My mom loves pasta, but she dislikes spaghetti. Similarly, she did not like lasagna. On the contrary, she loves macaroni. Likewise, she loves pancit guisado, pancit bihon, sotanghon, and palabok.

35cc0a85b89e3d1d5e8e.text: Before you go to the stadium to watch your favorite basketball game, make sure that you have your snacks and video camera that you will use during the game. Later, you will find it enjoyable when you can simultaneously eat while videotaping.

df541f409f796a68d68e.text: 3. Cause/Effect - shows the consequences of an action:

rows: consequently as a result therefore so
97b31c2622d61867311e.text: Cause Effect accordingly because due to since consequently as a result therefore so

15eb4ad03fad2fe0cf46.text: Since you have been a consistent honor student and a skillful one, therefore, there would be a possibility that you would graduate cum laude or be cited with technical skills award in college. As a result, you would have a better chance to find a job or be an entrepreneur, because some companies would prefer those applicants with impressive school records or those with technical skills.

46821257974d1951a0ee.text: 4. Illustration/Example add emphasis or introduce evidence:

8c16aaedd1ec8e472075.text: Illustration Example to demonstrate specifically truly for example such as namely

d68551bf4457bf7bd378.text: Mateo loves vegetables. Truly, he is happy to eat those every day - specifically, ‘pinakbet’, ‘chopsuey’, and vegetable salads. To demonstrate his love for vegetables, Mateo is planning a vegetable socials for all his friends.

b2823a0ce56d56dec7c3.text: 5. Addition adds information or reinforces ideas:

4a18e9250a0b00548f6c.text: in addition as well equally important then

e47ad942730ae9b74cea.text: Gabriel loves, respects, and obeys his parents. Moreover, he helps in the household chores if he is not studying. Furthermore, he is grateful that his parents are very supportive in every task he does.

274e594dcf1344067e8f.text: that is in other words to put it another way

e51a2359d943e7463d06.text: I mean in this case under certain circumstances

48977bce6be590575343.text: I love going to school; that is, I like it very much. In other words, I want to learn more. To put it another way, a school is one of the best places I need to go for me to learn better.

4aac0b7b15f279731e80.text: almost with this in mind possibly

b1cf94c44cd8b2613fde.text: With what was possibly the greatest fight of all times, the Filipino in the front lines faced the pandemic with bravery. They almost gave up but recovered. With this in mind, Filipinos have proven time and again to be resilient.

rows: as can be seen given this point to summarize to sum up so
in the long run in conclusion to conclude therefore finally
525d20529cf1f7d17c6b.text: Summary Conclusion as can be seen given this point to summarize to sum up so in the long run in conclusion to conclude therefore finally
